einzeiler: Danny McBride on crafting wild characters and building a filmmaking community.
kurzfassung: Danny McBride discusses his comedic work on projects like The Righteous Gemstones and Eastbound and Down. He talks about his early days at a film program in North Carolina and staying away from Hollywood. He also covers his new short story collection, Thrilling Tales of Modern Men.
stichpunkte: Finding collaborators at a public film program in North Carolina
Nurturing a filmmaker community far from Hollywood
Discussing the short story collection Thrilling Tales of Modern Men
beschreibung:
The man behind artful and goofy comedies like The Righteous Gemstones and Eastbound and Down talks about finding his people at an upstart public film program in North Carolina, crafting characters that are nothing like himself, and nurturing a community of like-minded filmmaker friends far away from Hollywood.
He also discusses his new short story collection Thrilling Tales of Modern Men.
